name: San Bruno Mountain SP
description: San Bruno Mountain State Park near Daly City and Brisbane offers hiking trails, habitat for rare plants and endangered butterflies, and views of San Francisco and the bay. It is operated by San Mateo County Parks.
fullDescription: San Bruno Mountain State Park near Daly City and Brisbane offers hiking trails, habitat for rare plants and endangered butterflies, and views of San Francisco and the bay. It is operated by San Mateo County Parks.
whatTheyOffer:
- Hiking, biking, and horseback riding trails
- Picnic areas and guided tours
- Group campsites
- Open 8am to before sunset; no dogs allowed
howToGetIt:
- Vehicle day use: $6
- Park is operated by San Mateo County Parks; call (650) 363-4020 to confirm hours and group camp reservations.

State park passes are not listed as accepted at this park.
address: 555 Guadalupe Canyon Parkway, Daly City, CA, 94014
keywords: San Bruno Mountain, state park, San Mateo County, Daly City, hiking, endangered butterflies, wildflowers, bay views
